# uv-cache

uv's package cache. Pruning removes only entries no longer needed.

**Name:** uv cache · **Category:** Package caches · **Status:** stable · **Systems:** macOS, Linux, Windows

Upstream docs: <https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/cache/>

**Detected when** one of `uv` is on PATH or one of `{cache}` exists.

## Paths

Resolved in this order: the tool's own command, then the environment variable, then the system default.

- `{cache}`: `uv cache dir` → `$UV_CACHE_DIR` → macOS `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/uv` → Linux `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/uv` → Windows `%LOCALAPPDATA%/uv/cache`

## Locations

| Path | Item | Safety | Why | Actions |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `{cache}` | uv cache | Safe | This is a download cache; it is fetched again when needed (`REDOWNLOADABLE`) | `native:uv-cache-prune`, `quarantine` |

## Native commands

- `native:uv-cache-prune` runs `uv cache prune` (timeout 600 s, freed space measured before and after)
